logp.method_description: The measurement of lipophilicity was in the mixed solution of isometric water and octanol. Dissolved the sample into trace amounts of ethanol, and then put it into the mixed solution. Oscillated and afterwards left it into settlement lamination. Finally sample concentration was tested in the water (Cw) and oil (Co), respectively. Lipophilicity was calculated according to equation: logPo/w = log(Co/Cw). The bigger the number of logPo/w is, the stronger the hydrophobicity.
